_doc: Halo & Horn prompt bible for AI-rendered hero art (ComfyUI, anime SDXL checkpoints). Design source: docs/dev/character-briefs.md (wins over this file if they disagree). Usage and rules: docs/dev/art-generation.md. Composed by tools/comfy/prompts.py; every prompt and every graph is checked against content_rules before it is written or sent. Prompts are Danbooru tag lists kept within 2 CLIP chunks (about 150 tokens); the 'natural' sentences are the brief in prose for people and metadata, not sent to the model unless a family sets use_natural.

content_rules._doc: Hard rules from docs/dev/character-briefs.md. Alluring fan-service up to the App Store 18+ limit; every character an ADULT (apparent age 20+, adult face, proportions and styling); suggestive but never explicit (no visible nipples, genitals or pubic area, including through sheer fabric; no sexual acts or poses mimicking them). tools/comfy/prompts.py refuses to compose, and comfy.py refuses to queue, a prompt that breaks these. Terms match whole words, weights ignored ('young' also catches 'young girl', 'young-looking').

noobai_vpred.label: NoobAI-XL v-prediction (and v-pred merges)
noobai_vpred.quality: masterpiece, best quality, newest, absurdres, highres, very awa
noobai_vpred.quality_negative: worst quality, old, early, low quality, lowres, signature, username, logo, bad hands, mutated hands, worst aesthetic, displeasing, furry, anthro, mammal, feral, sketch
noobai_vpred.notes: v-pred needs ModelSamplingDiscrete(v_prediction) and likes RescaleCFG 0.7, plain euler, low CFG. Washed out or burnt: --no-zsnr, or --cfg 4. NoobAI year tags: newest/recent/mid/early/old. Calibrated on NoobAI-XL-Vpred-v1.0 (2026-10-17, Uriela): these settings gave no washed-out or burnt image and CFG 5 changed almost nothing; without the model card's 'absurdres, highres' and a negative 'sketch', about a third of seeds came out as rough sketch line art. Quality A/B on Mordessa (2026-10-17, seeds 201010/201011/201015): the model card's own tags (prefix above with 'very awa', its negatives plus 'worst aesthetic') beat the Illustrious-style tags clearly (cleaner faces, smoother gloss, tidier line work); a model hires pass (4x-AnimeSharp, denoise 0.4, what --hires-mode auto picks when an upscaler is installed) beat latent hires at 0.5 and 0.6; finals get finalize.py's tiled 2x repaint (UltimateSDUpscale, denoise 0.35), far sharper at full size than a plain 2x stretch. Side effect: the new tags pull Mordessa toward a black leotard, so weight the outfit colours that matter.

composition.tags: full body, standing, contrapposto, looking at viewer
composition.natural: Full-body character art: the whole figure in frame from the top of the head to both feet, three-quarter view with the body turned toward the right side of the image, relaxed contrapposto standing pose with a gentle head tilt, wings, weapon and hair fully inside the frame, plain flat background with no ground shadow for a clean cutout.

_backgrounds_doc: Flat background for a clean cutout, chosen per hero for contrast with the figure's EDGES (hair, wings, armour): grey for white/gold designs (Celestial, Lucen), white for dark designs, green (chroma key; the cutout despills the fringe) for silver/grey hair, wings or armour that clash with both (Cassiel, Noctaire, Orrin, Ashra). Never green for green or teal designs (Sable). 'rim lighting' only on grey: on white it brightens the silhouette edge toward the background. A server background-removal node (BiRefNet/RMBG) makes this choice much less critical.

negative._doc: Kept short on purpose (at most 3 CLIP chunks; the safety terms alone are about 70 tokens): the required safety terms (gender-specific ones live in 'gender'), quality, framing and effects. Order: family quality, rating, the hero's negative_extra (first, so its weighted terms win the de-duplication), then these blocks. 'effects' keeps semi-transparent FX (glows, smoke, particles) out of the art: they spill into the flat background and break the cutout, and the rig draws its own VFX. 'halo' is added when the positive has a halo: the Danbooru halo tag is dominated by Blue Archive's school-age cast.

regions._doc: Expression regions as fractions of the FACE box [x0, y0, x1, y1]; the face box spans brow/hairline to chin and ear to ear.

smile.tags: happy, smile, closed eyes, open mouth

hurt.tags: pain, wince, clenched teeth, one eye closed, {eyes}

_variants_doc: Delivery names follow docs/dev/art-style.md section 2: variants/eyes_open.png or eyes_closed.png (whichever the base is not), mouth_open.png, smile.png, optional hurt.png. A hero's 'variants' entry may be a prompt string or {prompt, region}; missing ones use the 'tags' above ({eyes} = the hero's eye tags). 'conflicts' (and the variant's negative) must not appear in its positive prompt; with 'closed eyes' no eye colour may appear either (prompts.variant_conflicts). variant_set = what variants.py makes by default.
consistency: One checkpoint, one family block, one style block (style.tags + style.extra_tags + style.loras) and fixed sampler settings for all 15 heroes.
Fixed seeds per hero: candidates use seed_base + i; every candidate's seed, prompt, negative, model and settings are saved next to the image, so any candidate re-renders exactly.

After a master image is chosen, everything else derives from it (face polish, upscale, expression variants, fixes) through img2img/inpaint at low denoise with the master's own checkpoint (read from its metadata). Never re-roll the master; finalize.py keeps a copy of it as final/<id>_source.png.
New poses or outfits for a hero: img2img from the master (denoise 0.5-0.6) and, if the server has ComfyUI_IPAdapter_plus, --ref <master> to add an IPAdapter reference (weight 0.6-0.8).
Later: train a character LoRA per hero from 15-30 curated images (master + variants + refs) and list it in heroes.<id>.loras.
_heroes_doc: Tag fields are composed in this order: subject, adult_face, composition, body, hair, eyes, expression, head, wings_tail, outfit, footwear, accessories, weapon, pose (prompts.full_body). 'face' = identity tags for face crops. 'palette' overrides the faction palette. 'size' [w, h] overrides the family base size (wide frames for big wingspans). 'natural' = the brief in one sentence with the apparent age (metadata/docs). 'brief_gaps' = choices the brief does not make, or brief details left to the rig (glows, smoke), for the owner to veto. Budget: count tokens with the real CLIP BPE tokenizer (prompts.clip_stats undercounts words such as highleg, leotard, underboob, pectorals, contrapposto, polearm); every full-body prompt, art-farm overlay included, must fit 2 chunks, and the tag order inside a field is chosen so that no multi-word tag straddles the 75-token chunk break of the Animagine/farm prompt (a split tag such as 'partially | unzipped' is read as two unrelated words). Re-check both after any tag edit.
